errors.text_span: 每个语体对应一根竖直柱状条
errors.evidence: This is incorrect. The chart shows two vertical bars for each '语体' (corpus type): one for '男性' (male) and one for '女性' (female).
The description of the horizontal axis fails to mention the sub-categories '男性' (male) and '女性' (female), which are crucial for understanding what each bar represents.
The value written on top of the bar in subplot (a) is 4497, not 4387.
The value written on top of one of the tallest bars in subplot (a) is 6783, not 6739. The other tall bar is 6735.
The value labeled on top of the tallest bar in subplot (b) is 6526, not 6532.
The value labeled on one of the shorter bars in subplot (b) is 224, not 214.
